He opens the CCTV recording. The footage shows a man standing silently in the middle of his living room. The man looks exactly like him. The protagonist freezes. Slowly, he looks around his actual empty living room.

In complete darkness, the CCTV monitor turns back on. The screen displays the protagonist sitting peacefully in his chair, smiling directly at the camera.

CUT TO BLACK.

Ultra-realistic Korean live-action filmmaking, cinematic wide shots, controlled handheld camera movements, dramatic close-ups, natural skin textures, realistic shadows, subtle film grain, deep atmospheric lighting, professional color grading, and carefully composed framing.

SOUND DESIGN:

This is a Vision Pro headset, recreated by Claude from a SINGLE reference image, then exploded into individual components in a cinematic 3D animation.

1. CHATGPT — CREATE THE BLUEPRINT

Generate one reference image that establishes the entire visual direction: chrome frame, dark glass, orange accents, and a knitted headband.

Claude uses Three.js to recreate the headset, including its glass, lenses, 12 cameras, internal chip, and other components.

Every detail is compared against the reference before animation begins.

3. ONE TIMELINE — CONTROL THE ENTIRE SHOW

Every component gets its own moment.

The glass separates. The lenses emerge. Cameras detach. The chip, fan, and headband follow.

Even the information panels sync with the same timeline.

4. YOUR GPU — BRING IT TO LIFE

The animation renders frame by frame at 60 FPS, keeping every tiny mechanical detail sharp throughout the sequence.

THE FINAL RESULT?

A 24-second cinematic product breakdown where even the camera information card switches from ACTIVE to DETACHED as the headset comes apart.
